more_info.question: Property Insights and Emaar South Floor Plans

data.answer:
Emaar South Dubai features spacious villas along with several 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments in the area. Some of the top projects in the area include Golf Views, Golf Links, Urbana, and Expo Golf Villas. Golf Views is an apartment complex, while the rest are the Emaar South villa communities rapidly developing in phases. There are three phases of Urbana: Urbana 1 Emaar South, Urbana 2 Emaar South, and Urbana 3 Emaar South.

Off-Plan Projects in Emaar South

Emaar South's master plan includes various off-plan properties. Here is the list of the upcoming projects in the area.

Greenway by Emaar Properties 

It is an upcoming villa community of Emaar South. Greenway features 3 and 4-bedroom villas with modern architecture, breathtaking views, and expensive outdoor spaces.

Fairway Villas 3

You can find 4 and 5-bedroom homes in the Fariway Villas 3 development. Enjoy family-centric living at Fairway Villas surrounded by serene landscape.

Urbana II

Nestled in a serene environment, Urbana II by Emaar features tiered townhouses with 2 & 3 bedrooms. Residents can enjoy access to lush green parks, shopping outlets, leisure centers, swimming pools, and more at Emaar South Urbana.

Golf Views

Golf Views Emaar South by Emaar Properties is a magnificent apartment building with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units. Take in breathtaking golf course views with tons of luxury amenities at Golf Views.

Golf Links

The 3 to 5-bedroom villas in Golf Links Emaar South are meticulously designed offering easy access to gourmet restaurants and shopping outlets, as well as play areas, swimming pools, and parks.

Urbana III

Urbana III Emaar South is an amazing urban residential community in Emaar South. It features 2 and 4-tiered townhouses, and Dubai International Airport is just a few minute's drive away. The project is ready to move.

Parkside Expo Golf Villas Phase III

Choose from the 3- and 4-bedroom premium villas from the development of Parkside Expo Golf Villas Phase III. Nestled alongside the Main Boulevard, Emaar South Park Side is moments away from the Al Maktoum International Airport.

Greenview Expo Golf Villas 4

Emaar Properties's other venture, Expo Golf Villas Phase 4, known as Greenview Expo Golf Villas 4, features exclusive 3 and 4-bedroom residences in Emaar South, Dubai.

Expo Golf Villas 6 and Fairway Villas are the other off-plan projects in Emaar South.

Properties for Rent in Emaar South 

There are various properties available for rent in Emaar South. Those interested in renting apartments can consider the residential units in Golf Views, Emaar South Dubai. The two-building complex features 1, 2, and 3-bed flats spanning 1,000 sq. ft. The rental prices in Emaar South vary depending on the size and type of accommodation.

For 1-bedroom flats, prices start from AED 60,000 per annum. 2-bedroom apartments in Emaar South typically rent for around AED 69,999 annually. Renting a 3-bedroom flat in Emaar South typically costs approximately AED 110,000 per annum. For those interested in renting villas in Dubai South, options include Golf Links and Expo Golf Villas.

Rental prices for 3-bedroom villas typically range from AED 120,000 to AED 145,000 per year. Similarly, renting a 4-bedroom villa in Emaar South usually costs around AED 145,000 annually.

There are also 2-bedroom Emaar South townhouses available for rent, starting from AED 45,000 annually. The residential units in Urbana I, II, and III provide ample outdoor space and a parking garage. The annual rent for a 3-bedroom house in Emaar South is approximately AED 100,000.

Properties for Sale in Emaar South

In Emaar South, a 1-bedroom apartment is available for sale at AED 770,000. Buying a 2-bedroom apartment typically costs around AED 1.05M. Larger units, such as 3-bedroom apartments, start from AED 1.7M.

For villas, 3-bedroom units start from AED 1.4M. 4-bedroom villas for sale in Emaar South begin at AED 2.2M, whereas 5-bedroom villas in Emaar South start at AED 6.4M.

Residential clusters like Urbana and Greenview 3 in Emaar South also offer tiered and standard townhouse units. The starting price for a 3-bedroom house is AED 1.6M. Similarly, 4-bedroom townhouses are available for purchase at approximately AED 2.2M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Emaar Dubai South?

data.answer:
Emaar Dubai South offers a harmonious blend of modern convenience, natural beauty, and community spirit.  The community boasts a range of amenities, including parks, landscaped green spaces, recreational facilities, retail outlets, dining options, schools, and healthcare facilities. Whether exploring the championship golf course, spending time in the serene parks, or engaging in community events, residents find ample opportunities for leisure and relaxation. 

Public Transportation in Emaar South

For commuters relying on public transportation near Emaar South, there are two nearby bus stations accessible. One is the Dubai World Central, Staff Village bus stop, reachable in approximately 9 minutes. Another option is the Dubai World Central, Freight House 2 bus stop, which can be reached in 6 minutes.

Additionally, individuals can opt for an RTA bus to reach a metro station close to Emaar South. The nearest metro station is the UAE Exchange station, which takes approximately 17 minutes to reach.

Supermarkets in Emaar South

South Village serves as a community mall catering to Emaar South residents, spanning approximately 22,000 square meters of land. Among its features is a sizable outlet of Geant Express, offering a variety of edible items ranging from imported to frozen and fresh.

Additionally, a small convenience store, Allday Minimart, is conveniently located just a few minutes drive away. Nearby, Grand Hyper Sakany stands as a hypermarket affiliated with Sakany Accommodation. For those situated near the Dubai South Headquarters, Zoom Supermarket provides another option, reachable within approximately 7 minutes by car.

Shopping in Emaar South

South Village is a community mall designed exclusively for residents of Emaar South. Spanning over a land area of approximately 22,000 square meters, the mall offers a comprehensive array of amenities and services to enhance the residential experience. From retail outlets to dining options, recreational facilities, and essential services, South Village aims to cater to the diverse needs of its residents.

The nearest and most notable option for retail is Ibn Battuta Mall, accessible within a 26-minute drive. This mall distinguishes itself with themed sections inspired by various countries like China, India, Spain, and more.

Schools Near Emaar South

Near Emaar South, several schools offer diverse educational options for families. Dive Green Private School, located approximately 25 minutes away, provides a comprehensive curriculum emphasizing sustainability and environmental awareness. South View School, just a bit further at 27 minutes away, offers a British curriculum catering to students from Foundation Stage to Year 13.

Ranches Primary School, situated about 29 minutes away, focuses on providing a nurturing learning environment for primary-grade students, fostering their academic and personal development. Each of these schools contributes to the educational landscape near Emaar South, providing families with options tailored to their preferences and needs.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Emaar South Area

The nearest mosque to Emaar South is situated near Al Maktoum International Airport. Known as the Al Maktoum Airport Mosque, it can be conveniently reached within a 7-minute car ride.

The church complex in Jebel Ali is accessible within less than half an hour by car, offering a place for Christian residents to gather for religious services. Notable churches in Jebel Ali Village include Mor Ignatius Jacobite Syrian Orthodox Cathedral Dubai, Covenant Hope Church, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, and St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church.

Temples near Emaar South include the Sikh Gurdwara, Guru Nanak Darbar, and Hindu Temple in Jebel Ali, reachable within approximately a 20-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals in Emaar South Dubai

The nearest medical facilities to Emaar South include NMC Royal Hospital, DIP, Al Maktoum Airport Clinic, and Mediclinic Meadows.

Given that Emaar South is still in the development phase, there are limited clinics nearby. The closest one is located within the airport vicinity. Al Maktoum Airport Clinic serves as a crucial resource for residents during emergencies, boasting state-of-the-art medical equipment and capable staff to address various medical needs. Accessible within a 17-minute car ride, it provides prompt medical assistance when required.

Emaar South Location & Nearby Areas

Emaar South is adjacent to the Al Maktoum International Airport, Jebel Ali Port, and other industrial and commercial developments.

Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Jebel Ali, and Dubai Industrial Area are some of the neighboring communities of Emaar South.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Emaar South

data.answer:
Emaar South offers a range of activities and attractions to keep residents and visitors engaged. Here are some things to do in the area. Enjoy a round of golf at the championship golf course within Emaar South, explore the green spaces and parks, or make use of community amenities such as swimming pools, playgrounds, and recreational areas.

Restaurants In and Near Emaar South Dubai

Various restaurants in Dubai South cater to the residents of Emaar South as well. These include Nook Restaurant, WXYZ Bar Aloft, Pushkin Restaurant and Cafe, Olives Restaurant, and Golo Italia Restaurant.

Nook Restaurant offers delectable dishes in Dubai South's Aviation City, perfect for aviation enthusiasts, while WXYZ Bar at Aloft Dubai South serves up refreshing drinks and a vibrant atmosphere for a memorable night out.

Pushkin Restaurant and Cafe, nestled in Dubai South headquarters, presents a blend of culinary delights and corporate ambiance. Olives Restaurant invites diners to savor Mediterranean flavors in a cozy setting. Similarly, Golo Italia Restaurant promises an authentic taste of Italy with its flavorful dishes and charming ambiance.

Hotels In and Near the Emaar South Dubai Area

Aloft Dubai South Hotel is the nearest hotel to Emaar South. The 4-star boutique hotel at Al Maktoum International Airport features a swimming pool, 24-hour front desk and many other facilities.

Located just 4 minutes from Emaar Dubai South, Holiday Inn Dubai Al Maktoum Airport offers convenient proximity to the airport and comfortable lodging for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel boasts contemporary rooms and suites, complete with amenities like flat-screen TVs, minibars, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can dine at the hotel's restaurant, which serves a diverse selection of international dishes.

Other amenities include a rooftop swimming pool, fitness center, and meeting facilities suitable for business gatherings. The hotel's strategic location also ensures easy access to nearby attractions.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Emaar South

One of the notable attractions near Emaar South is the Al Marmoom Lakes. These expansive lakes offer a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of the city, providing opportunities for outdoor activities such as birdwatching, picnics, and photography.

Motiongate Dubai and Expo City Dubai are the other nearby attractions. Motiongate Dubai is a Hollywood-inspired theme park with exciting shows, adrenaline-pumping rides and plenty of movie-themed fun!

The Emaar South Golf Course is a premier destination for golf enthusiasts, offering a world-class golfing experience in the heart of Dubai. It also provides state-of-the-art facilities, including a clubhouse, practice areas, and professional instruction for golfers of all levels. Whether you're a seasoned player or a novice looking to improve your game, the Emaar South Golf Course promises an unforgettable golfing experience amidst stunning surroundings.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Emaar South incorporates numerous outdoor amenities such as jogging tracks, paved walkways, biking tracks, landscaped playgrounds, and communal swimming pools. Each residential sub-community also features central parks that enhance residents' outdoor experiences. Moreover, Emaar South Golf Course includes an 18-hole championship course, making it an excellent place for golf enthusiasts.

The Western Gym, situated within Sapphire Mall, offers a convenient option for fitness buffs. However, reaching it requires a drive of approximately 20 minutes. Despite the community's ongoing development, there are currently limited choices for salons and spas. Residents may need to travel to the main city, which is approximately a 30-minute drive away, to access a broader range of beauty services.

While Emaar South provides essential amenities such as parks, playgrounds, and communal pools, there may be a lack of diverse retail options, dining establishments, and entertainment venues within the community itself. Residents may need to travel to neighboring areas for a wider range of amenities and services.

What is the difference between Dubai South and Emaar South?

The main difference between Dubai South and Emaar South lies in their ownership and development. Dubai South is a larger master development initiated by the Dubai government, encompassing various residential, commercial, and industrial projects to promote economic growth and sustainability. Emaar South, on the other hand, is a specific community within Dubai South developed by Emaar Properties, one of the leading real estate developers in the region. While both are part of the same master development, Emaar South is a distinct residential and commercial neighborhood within the broader Dubai South project.

How far is Emaar South from Dubai Mall?

The distance between Emaar South and Dubai Mall, one of the largest shopping malls in the world, is approximately 27 kilometers (around 17 miles). Depending on traffic conditions and the chosen route, the travel time by car is typically around 20 to 30 minutes.

What is the nearest metro station to Emaar South?

The nearest metro station to Emaar South is the UAE Exchange station, which is part of the Dubai Metro's Red Line. It is located approximately 17 kilometers (around 10.5 miles) away from Emaar South. Depending on traffic conditions, the travel time by car from Emaar South to the UAE Exchange station is approximately 15 to 20 minutes.

Where is Emaar South?

Emaar South is a residential and commercial development located in the southern part of Dubai. It is strategically positioned near the Expo 2020 site and Al Maktoum International Airport.

What is Emaar South’s Construction Update?

The project will be completed in phases, with the first phase scheduled for completion in 2025.

data.content:
Emaar South is a vibrant master-planned community located in Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties, one of the region's most renowned developers, Emaar South offers a unique blend of residential, commercial, leisure, and hospitality developments, designed to create a modern and sustainable living environment.

The community is conveniently located close to the Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport.  It is a sub-community of Dubai South. Despite being located on the outskirts of Dubai, the community is well connected with the rest of the city via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Emirates Road (E611).

It is a part of the expansive Dubai South master development dedicated to establishing a sustainable and cohesive community centered around economic progress and innovation. With Al Maktoum Airport set to become the biggest airport in the world, properties in the vicinity present attractive investment opportunities.
